name: Steam
description: Show Steam activity, friends online, playtime and achievement progress. Add a separate instance for each person and combine them on household pages.
author: FiestaBoard

api_key.title: Steam Web API Key
api_key.description: Your personal key from steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey. Use localhost for a local installation. Leave blank only if STEAM_API_KEY is set on the server.

profile.title: Steam Profile
profile.description: Your profile or anyone else whose activity is visible: paste a steamcommunity.com/id/NAME or /profiles/ID URL, or a 17-digit Steam ID.

display_name.title: Display Name (optional)
display_name.description: Friendly label for this profile, such as Jeff or Husband. Blank uses the Steam name.

display_mode.title: Display Mode
display_mode.description: Choose the ready-made board layout. All variables remain available in every mode.

game_id.title: Featured Game ID
game_id.description: 0 selects the current game, then a recent game. To track a specific game, use the number after /app/ in its Steam store URL. This controls playtime and achievements.

favorite_friends.title: Favorite Friends (optional)
favorite_friends.description: Comma-separated 17-digit Steam IDs. Blank uses this profile’s visible friends list. Counts cover only favorites when set; profiles can be added even when the friends list is private.

refresh_seconds.title: Activity Refresh (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: Presence refresh. Game statistics refresh every 5 minutes; the friends list every 15 minutes.

env_vars.name: STEAM_API_KEY
env_vars.description: Personal Steam Web API key, used by instances whose API Key setting is blank.

is_playing.description: Whether Steam exposes an in-game activity

current_game.description: Game currently playing, unavailable if not visible

current_game_id.description: Current Steam app ID, unavailable if unavailable

game_id.description: Selected, current, or a recent game ID

playtime_hours.description: Featured game lifetime hours; unavailable if hidden

game_recent_hours.description: Featured game hours in the last two weeks; unavailable if unavailable

recent_hours.description: Hours across recently played games in the last two weeks

library_count.description: Visible owned-game count, not family library size

recent_status.description: Availability of recent games and playtime

friends_online.description: Online friends including those playing; unavailable if unavailable

friends_playing.description: Friends currently in game; unavailable if unavailable

friends_total.description: Number of friends in selected scope

achievement_percent.description: Completion percentage; unavailable if unknown or no achievements

latest_achievement.description: Latest unlocked achievement in the featured game

latest_unlock_time.description: Latest known unlock Unix timestamp; unavailable if no positive unlock time exists

line_1.description: Row 1 of the selected display mode, adapted to the current board

line_2.description: Row 2 of the selected display mode, adapted to the current board

line_3.description: Row 3 of the selected display mode, adapted to the current board

line_4.description: Row 4 of the selected display mode, adapted to the current board

line_5.description: Row 5 of the selected display mode, adapted to the current board

line_6.description: Row 6 of the selected display mode, adapted to the current board

playtime_available.description: Whether featured-game lifetime hours are visible; use for a template fallback

recent_available.description: Whether total two-week hours are visible; use for a template fallback
